question_text: Are all federal flood insurance requirements met including minimum ratings?

defect_options.response: Loan approved even though the property is part of the Coastal Barrier Resource System

finding.description: The subject property is or is proposed to be located within the Coastal Barrier Resources System.

defect_options.response: No, the SFHDF does not correctly identify the borrowers/subject property address/lender/servicer

finding.description: The flood determination (SFHDF) does not correctly identify the borrowers, subject property address and/or current lender/servicer.

defect_options.response: No, property is located in a SFHA and escrows were not established for collection of flood premiums

finding.description: Escrow was not established for the collection of flood insurance premiums and fees on behalf of the borrower where the subject property is located in a special flood hazard area.

defect_options.response: The flood insurance deductible requirements as per property type were not met

finding.description: The flood insurance deductible requirements as per property type were not met.

defect_options.response: No, the escrow account does not include premiums and fees for payment of the flood insurance policy

finding.description: Flood insurance is required and the escrow account established at consummation does not include all premiums and fees for payment of the flood insurance policy.

defect_options.response: No, the Notice of Special Flood Hazard Area was not mailed or delivered to the borrower(s)

finding.description: The Notice of Special Flood Hazards and Availability of Federal Disaster Relief Assistance was not mailed to the applicants within a reasonable time before the completion of the transaction.

defect_options.response: No, the SFHDF fee charged to the borrower exceeds the actual costs + life of loan monitoring fee

finding.description: The fee for the Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form (SFHDF) charged to the borrower was not limited to actual costs of the determination, plus life-of-loan monitoring, where applicable.

defect_options.response: No, a complete and accurate SFHDF was not used to evaluate the loan for flood insurance requirements

finding.description: The file does not reflect a complete and accurate Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form (SFHDF) was used to evaluate the loan for flood insurance requirements.

defect_options.response: No, sufficient flood coverage was not in effect as of the date of loan consummation

finding.description: The file does not contain evidence of sufficient flood coverage in effect as of the date of loan consummation.

defect_options.response: No, the Notice of Special Flood Hazard Area does not contain all required disclosure language

finding.description: The Notice of Special Flood Hazard Area does not contain all required disclosure language in accordance with the model clauses in Appendix A (Rev. 01-01-2016).

defect_options.response: Private flood insurance policy does not meet the definition or include the prerequisite statement

finding.description: Where the property is located in a SFHA and a private flood insurance policy is received that a) meets the definition of private flood insurance, or b) includes the following statement within the policy or as an endorsement to the policy: “This policy meets the definition of private flood insurance contained in 42 U.S.C. 4012a(b)(7) and the corresponding regulation.”, the private flood insurance policy was not accepted. [Mandatory on or after July 1, 2019]

defect_options.response: Private flood policy discretionary acceptance requirements were not met

finding.description: Where the property is located in a SFHA and a private flood insurance policy issued by a private insurer is accepted in accordance with the discretionary acceptance requirements, the policy was not issued by an insurer permitted under the regulation and/or the policy does not provide a sufficient amount of insurance or cover both the mortgagor(s) and the mortgagee(s) as loss payees.

citations.title: Flood Insurance Requirements for All Property Types

notes: 12 defect options cover CBRS/OPA, escrow, deductible, notices, SFHDF fee/form, sufficient coverage, and private flood insurance acceptance. B7-3-06 governs the substantive flood-insurance-required determination, community eligibility, acceptable policies (incl. private flood equivalency + insurer rating), and the deductible table (covers O-FHA-00545, O-FNM-56261, O-FDPA-51120 in substance). The FDPA-procedural options (O-FDPA-50004 determination accuracy, O-FDPA-51089/-50001 escrow, O-FDPA-50002/-50003 notice mailing+content, O-FDPA-51091 SFHDF fee cap, O-FDPA-51090 SFHDF form completeness, O-FDPA-50000 sufficient coverage at consummation, O-FDPA-51800 private flood discretionary acceptance) are Flood Disaster Protection Act / Reg-driven compliance checks not separately detailed as their own topic in the available Selling Guide corpus; no dedicated section found via grep for SFHDF fee, escrow, or notice-content requirements. Card also shares exception_code O-FNM-56261 (identical description) with PC::O-FNM-15438 (Insurance card 5 of this batch) — near-duplicate scope across two ACES questions, not merged since the remaining 11 vs 10 codes are distinct.

notes: 10 of 11 defect options map directly onto B7-3-03 (master policy: broad-coverage form, replacement-cost claims basis, 5% deductible + per-unit exception, 100% replacement value, boiler/machinery lesser-of-$2M, building-ordinance/inflation-guard special coverage), B7-3-04 (HO-6/individual unit coverage), B7-4-01 (general liability), and B7-4-02 (fidelity/crime). The outlier is O-FNM-59134 (New York Mortgage Insurance Determination, IPC adjustment) — this is a mortgage-insurance computation actually governed by B7-1-01's 'LTV Ratio Determination in New York State' subsection, not by the property-insurance sections cited here. Not added as a 5th citation (schema caps at 4) since it covers only 1 of 11 options; flagged here instead of silently omitted.

notes: B7-3-06 governs CBRS/OPA (O-FNM-00574), NFIP community eligibility (O-FNM-56258, exact taxonomy match), condo RCBAP / co-op General Property Form verification (O-FNM-56259/-56260), deductible-by-property-type (O-FNM-56261), acceptable-policy private-flood equivalency + rating (O-FNM-55380), and coverage-in-effect (O-FNM-00826). B7-3-08 governs the flood mortgagee-clause option (O-FNM-56262). Two options lack corpus backing: O-FRD-00565 (120-day SFHDF age / life-of-loan cert) and O-BP-54670 (flood insurance coverage calculator use) are FEMA/FDPA procedural-tool requirements not detailed as a distinct topic in the extracted Selling Guide sections (grepped, no hit). O-FNM-00533 (Flood Hazard Determination) appears twice with the SAME exception_code but DIFFERENT response text ('determination was not made on the SFHDF' vs 'life of loan flood certification is not in the file or ratings not met') — not a literal duplicate per the dedup rule (response text differs), so both rows are kept as separate defect_options. Shares O-FNM-56261 (identical description) with PC::O-FED-14400 — see that card's notes.
